Library Function - Single Match _START_SYS
Libraries: katana 10 1, ninja 1 1
Load byte from address in r6 (StageOrder_TagMode), then increment r6
Store byte into address pointed by r5 (e.g. DAT_8c2357a5, part of a stage order list)
Increment r5 to point to next byte
Load next byte from r6 (next stage ID)
Store into next location pointed to by r5 (e.g. DAT_8c2357a6)
Check if r5 has passed r7 (end pointer or limit)
If not finished, repeat the loop (copy next stage pair)
Once done, branch to next logic (could be applying or finalizing stage order)
r0 = character ID (or index into table)
r1 = pointer to character lighting type table DAT_8c236872
r0 = r0 * 2 (word indexing, each entry is 2 bytes)
r0 = *(r1 + r0), i.e. load lighting type for this character
if not equal, branch to alternative lighting math
delay slot: r14 = *r7, probably base lighting pointer
r2 = *(r6 + 0x14), this is a lighting preset value (e.g., 0x2200)
r14 += r2 (offset addition if lighting type is 1)
r14 -= r2 (inverse offset if lighting type != 1)
Load the player's age into r2
